scope_note: Every fact here was observed on the documentdb-local container ddb-engine-test (open-source DocumentDB engine and gateway at the hello.internal / pg_extension version above, buildInfo version 7.0.0). It is evidence about the open-source engine and gateway at that version only; it does not prove how the managed Azure DocumentDB service behaves.
deviations_from_spec: The spec's psql commands (-U postgres) fail because the image has no 'postgres' role; both are recorded as run, and the same SQL was rerun as role 'documentdb' (the image's superuser and OS user) with -d postgres (psql otherwise defaults to a nonexistent 'documentdb' database) and -X (skips the image's ~/.psqlrc, which prints two SET lines).

Extra steps beyond the spec, for context: createSearchIndexes static mapping and the PyMongo helper, $search text without an index name, the list_search_indexes helper, a raw $changeStream aggregate, database-level watch() on t_parity, HNSW and IVF control indexes and a cosmosSearch control query, the $currentOp stage, plain connectionStatus, hello with saslSupportedMechs requested for the test user and for an unknown user, an unauthenticated MONGODB-OIDC saslStart with an empty payload (no token), a serverStatus before/after counter check (10 inserts, 10 finds, 10 pings in t_parity), engine feature settings and image identity. client.watch() was not run because a cluster-wide stream would read other databases.
